items.claim: Default codec rejects legacy protobuf messages
items.consequence: The previous codec accepted legacy generated messages that implement the v1 Message interface but lack ProtoReflect. The repository includes such generated messages, so RPCs that marshal or unmarshal them now fail at the default serialization boundary.
items.proposed_fix: Accept legacy protoadapt.MessageV1 values and adapt them with protoadapt.MessageV2Of in Marshal and Unmarshal, retaining support for v2 messages.

residual_risks.title: Legacy status details may fail to decode through the v2 registry
residual_risks.why_it_matters: WithDetails continues to accept legacy MessageV1 details, but Details now decodes each Any with the v2 Any.UnmarshalNew path instead of the former legacy ptypes resolver. Concrete legacy detail types returned by Any.UnmarshalNew were not independently verified, so compatibility at this decoding boundary remains uncertain.
evidence: Base internal/status/status.go used ptypes.UnmarshalAny(any, detail) to decode status detail messages.
